deadline.value: Applications are rolling, but for financial support completed applications must reach the department by January 15 for fall.
deadline.quote: for financial support purposes completed applications must be received in the department on or before the following dates | Fall term/semester January 15

gre_general.value: Applicants must submit GRE scores in the verbal, quantitative and analytical writing sections.
gre_general.quote: Submission of GRE scores (verbal, quantitative, and analytical writing sections) is required

gre_subject.value: The subject GRE is for diagnostic purposes and is not required for admission.
gre_subject.quote: The appropriate GRE subject test is also required for diagnostic purposes, but not for admission

supervisor.value: A faculty member must agree to be the applicant's major professor before admission.
supervisor.quote: Agreement by a faculty member to serve as the applicant’s major professor (i.e. advisor) is required for programs in biology, biochemistry and molecular biology

funding.value: The page ties funding to deadlines but does not say most students are funded.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's with 24 life-science hours (12 advanced) is required; a master's is only desirable.
entry_route.quote: Bachelor’s degree with 24 hours, 12 of which are advanced, in a life science or appropriate related science is required for programs in biology, biochemistry and molecular biology | a master’s degree in a life science with a research-based thesis is desirable

notes: One departmental page covers the Biology PhD and the Biochemistry and Molecular Biology PhD, so biomed is listed as also_fields. The page is marked ARCHIVED CATALOG in the 2025-26 catalog. Department pages (biology.unt.edu) returned 502.
name: Biology and Biochemistry & Molecular Biology PhD
